grammar.summary: 本课学习 need 作实义动词与 mustn't 的辨析。

points.title: need 实义动词用法
points.explanation: need like a regular verb: I needn't have...? 本课 need 作实义动词：Do you need...? 后接 to do；作情态动词多用于否定 needn't（不必）。

points.title: mustn't 与 needn't
points.explanation: mustn't = 禁止（别做）；needn't = 不必（不做也行）。I needn't remind you of that. 表"没必要"。
